The scriptural citations (Jer 2:13; John 7:38) reinforce the Spirit's role without contradicting the book's dual focus.

The relationship is RE FINED, as the book preserves the consensus category of God's life-giving gift centered on the Spirit but broadens its extension by equating the word of God as equally central, a nuance not elevated in the blind responses. The citations provide partial support, anchoring the Spirit aspect but leaving the word component unaddressed in the printed references. This refinement reflects a theological synthesis rather than replacement of the core identification.
